findings.title: The authored memory port is an atomic proxy, not the frozen M803 eight-channel boundary
findings.evidence: Frozen M803 has per-bank bank_req_valid/ready and bank_rsp_valid/ready plus epoch, slot, generation and tag ownership. M1780 has one mem_req_valid/ready and one mem_rsp_valid/ready carrying all eight banks, with only group/half/slice identity.
findings.impact: Unequal bank readiness, out-of-order per-bank responses, slot ownership and stale-response behavior are removed. Directed cycles and DC area of this proxy cannot be called a same-resource M803/C2 result.
findings.required_repair: Use the real eight independent bank protocol and transaction identity in both modes, or explicitly downgrade and rename the island as a standalone proxy that cannot admit the C2 specialization.

findings.title: No frozen typed-signed M803/M519 consumer exists at the claimed handoff
findings.evidence: Frozen M218/M519 groups contain source count, binary bank-valid mask and source channels, but no signed source value. M1780 adds issue_source_value and performs add/subtract in its own eight-token Acc24 array. The frozen M803 accumulator contexts are output-block contexts for a token, not an already-compatible eight-token signed handoff.
findings.impact: The comment that a later composition can replace the local ledger with the admitted M803 service is not executable without a new additive typed-signed bridge/service and explicit context mapping.
findings.required_repair: Build an additive typed-signed C2 service/bridge with eight token identities, real M803 bank protocol, independent Acc24 ownership and exact terminal mapping; bind its source identity before launch.

findings.title: Illegal memory-response and independent-bank protocol attacks are absent
findings.evidence: The TB memory always echoes the requested group/half/slice. The sole protocol attack is load_source_value=+2. No stale/mismatched response is injected and no unequal per-bank ready/response ordering exists.
findings.impact: The existing illegal_rsp path and stable-under-backpressure behavior are not exercised at the boundary that matters.
findings.required_repair: Add mismatched identity, duplicate/stale response, per-bank skew and sticky-fault/reset recovery tests on the repaired real interface.

findings.title: Eviction and overflow obligations are only implicit
findings.evidence: The 12-group/capacity-8 count implies eviction, but there is no explicit eviction cover/counter. The TB only rejects unexpected numeric_overflow. An independent bound proves the default legal workload cannot overflow Acc24: 48*16*128=98,304 < 2^23.
findings.impact: Coverage receipts cannot separately show the requested eviction event or the reason overflow is unreachable.
findings.required_repair: Add an eviction cover/ledger and seal the Acc24 bound as an assertion or contract proof; retain a no-overflow assertion for the legal point.

findings.title: Weight-beat terminology is ambiguous
findings.evidence: M1780's 1152/144 counters count atomic eight-bank aggregate responses. At the frozen M803 scalar-bank pins these correspond to 9216/1152 accepted scalar bank beats when all banks are active.
findings.impact: A paper table could accidentally compare aggregate response cycles with scalar bank transactions.
findings.required_repair: Name both aggregate bundle beats and scalar bank beats explicitly in future ledgers.

disposition.reason: The lossless reuse opportunity and standalone arithmetic are viable, but physical/protocol composition with the admitted C2 boundary is not yet implemented.
